intro: Shanda is a night elf priestess and mentor located within the hollow trunk of Aldrassil in Shadowglen. Serving the Sisterhood of Elune, she instructs novice night elf priests in the fundamental prayers, wards, and rites of the Moon Goddess. Her guidance helps fledgling acolytes balance the light of Elune with their duties in defending Teldrassil.

p: Standing within the tranquil sanctuary of Aldrassil, Shanda serves as one of the first spiritual guides for young night elves dedicated to Elune. While the druids tend to the waking roots and boughs of Teldrassil, priestesses like Shanda ensure that the spiritual heart of the Kaldorei remains tethered to the White Lady. She instructs new initiates on channeling lunar grace for healing and protective wards, preparing them to face the corruption creeping into the boughs of the World Tree.

When young priests awaken to their calling in Shadowglen, they are directed to Shanda to prove their devotion and learn their first prayers. Through rites such as In Favor of Elune, she tests their resolve and provides them with blessed regalia and basic incantations. Under her tutelage, students learn that a priestess of the Kaldorei must be both a gentle hand to the wounded and a steadfast shield against the shadows.
